mission.title: urunc: Come up with a common interface for the sim communication with contianerd
mission.description: Come up with a common interface for the sim communication with contianerd. Community-requested feature.

steps.title: Check current urunc deployment
steps.description:
Verify your urunc version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n urunc -l app.kubernetes.io/name=urunc
helm list -n urunc 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working urunc installation.

steps.title: Review urunc configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant urunc configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n urunc -l app.kubernetes.io/name=urunc
kubectl get configmap -n urunc -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=urunc
```
We currently have two PRs https://github.com/urunc-dev/urunc/pull/639 and https://github.com/urunc-dev/urunc/pull/565 which both create anew taskService plugin for urunc's contianerd shim and both setup a new connection with contianerd.

steps.title: Upgrade urunc to include the fix
steps.description:
If the fix is included in a newer release, upgrade urunc:
```bash
helm repo update
helm upgrade urunc urunc/urunc --namespace urunc
```
Verify the upgrade:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n urunc
helm list -n urunc
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n urunc -l app.kubernetes.io/name=urunc
kubectl get events -n urunc --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Come up with a common interface for the sim communication…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
The containerd access layer adds a narrow `Session` helper that owns a
short-lived gRPC connection, namespace propagation, task-level container
metadata lookup, and gRPC error conversion. It keeps the raw connection private
and exposes only common task/container metadata through getters.

The generated service-client constructors are package-private helpers.
